claim: A new velocity faster than maxSpeed is cut to maxSpeed, and one slower than minSpeed is lifted to minSpeed, keeping its direction.
derivation: Only the beacon rule is on (w_b = 4, v* = 6, a_max = 50). Beacons sit at (15, 5) and (27, 25).
A (5, 5) moving (3.5, 0): the nearest beacon is (15, 5), 10 away (the other is 15.62), desired (6, 0), so B_A = 4 · ((6, 0) − (3.5, 0)) = (10, 0) (E6).
B (5, 25) moving (0.5, 0): the beacon at (27, 25) is 10 away to the left across the seam (22 − 32 = −10), nearer than (15, 5) at 15.62; desired (−6, 0), B_B = (−26, 0).
v′_B = (0.5 − 26/60, 0) = (0.066667, 0) is below v_min = 0.45 but not zero, so it is scaled to (0.45, 0) in the same direction; x′_B = 5 + 0.45/60 = 5.0075.
